quarterly_data.quarter: Zhongheng Electric annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: 2025 revenue RMB 2,137,227,829.77, up 8.94%; net profit attributable to shareholders RMB 126,374,581.15, up 15.27%; net profit excluding non-recurring items RMB 115,324,081.29, up 38.73%. Quarterly revenue rose from RMB 388,158,898.05 in the first quarter to RMB 719,075,975.46 in the fourth quarter (fourth-quarter net profit RMB 53,801,433.93). Operating cash flow RMB 243,302,503.31, down 48.06%, mainly because more cash was paid for goods and services. Contract liabilities stood at RMB 327,195,221.18 at year-end against RMB 161,974,347.31 at the start of the year.

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhongheng Electric annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: data-center power revenue RMB 775,760,637.60, up 16.10% (36.30% of revenue; gross margin 20.71%, down 1.40 points); telecom power systems RMB 384,226,545.94, up 25.75% (gross margin 26.75%); power-operation power systems RMB 473,677,203.64, down 1.06%; software development, sales and services RMB 418,902,082.85, up 7.30% (gross margin 34.58%). The communications-industry segment had revenue of RMB 1,159,987,183.54 (up 19.13%, gross margin 22.71%) and sold 90,387 sets (up 26.28%; output 87,528 sets, inventory 24,408 sets). Export sales were RMB 87,554,145.43, up 177.78% (4.10% of revenue).
quarterly_data.figure: RMB 775,760,637.60 data-center power revenue (+16.10%, 36.30% of revenue, 20.71% gross margin)

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhongheng Electric annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: deepening cooperation with leading domestic cloud providers, the company won Alibaba projects for Panama 2.0 power systems, STS and ATS power systems in Alibaba's self-built and several third-party co-built data centers; Tencent elastic DC system projects in Tencent's self-built and several third-party co-built data centers; ByteDance precision power-distribution projects in its self-built and third-party co-built data centers; and an HVDC power project for a Bank of China financial data center. With Zhongyi Energy it is advancing an 800V energy-integrated DC microgrid project built on its new-generation 800V DC power system.

quarterly_data.quarter: Zhongheng Electric annual report: 2025 Annual Report (04-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2025 annual report: R&D spending RMB 171,194,945.84, up 7.11% (8.01% of revenue, none capitalised); 653 R&D staff (31.50% of employees). Intelligent-computing-center HVDC rectifier module development and a data-center ultra-efficient wide-range-input power supply device are in progress, both aimed at volume production and sales; the DC power system STS switching unit, the intelligent redundant power-switching core module and the HVDC full-domain sensing and O&M control system were completed, aimed at volume production and sales.
